content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Fonts online

This is sovereign commerce infrastructure — a complete digital commerce stack designed to operate independently of platforms like Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, or Lemon Squeezy. It’s built on open, verifiable tools that you own and control. For font creators, this means no more platform restrictions, no more fund holds, and no more dependency on third-party [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-trap-most-creators-3|payment]] processors. The stack uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements. This [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-4|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-behind-bitcoin-payments-digital-downloads-stripe-8|The Real]] is not a temporary fix — it’s a permanent solution that gives you full data ownership and operational autonomy.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack begins with a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which serves as your storefront. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring fast and scalable operations. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, providing a lightweight yet robust database. File delivery is managed via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring instant access to purchased fonts. Payments are processed through NOWPayments, which verifies on-chain transactions and triggers automatic product delivery via webhook. The system is designed to be modular — each component can be swapped or upgraded without disrupting the entire stack. This architecture is pressure-tested in environments like Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and financial isolation are realities, not hypotheticals.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This stack is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or unreliable. Font designers in Nigeria, template creators in Pakistan, and course sellers in Ghana are the primary beneficiaries. These creators face systemic exclusion from platforms like Stripe and PayPal, which operate in less than 25% of the world’s countries. The stack provides a structural alternative, not a workaround. It’s for those who value ownership over convenience, permanence over platform dependency, and control over compromise. If you’re selling fonts, templates, or digital products and want to operate on your own terms, this infrastructure is your foundation.
Stripe operates in less than 25% of the world’s countries. Build infrastructure that works everywhere.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack’s components are selected for their reliability, cost-effectiveness, and interoperability. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide free, fast hosting with global CDN distribution. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, ensuring scalability and efficiency. Supabase or Google Sheets serve as the order database, offering flexibility and ease of use. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 manage file delivery, ensuring instant access to purchased products. NOWPayments handles crypto payments, supporting 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements. Each component is open, verifiable, and fully owned by you. There are no subscriptions, no platform fees, and no hidden dependencies.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this stack, start by choosing your hosting platform — GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Configure your order database with Supabase or Google Sheets. Link your file delivery system to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, selecting low-fee networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON. Test the entire stack end-to-end to ensure seamless operation. Once deployed, you own the entire infrastructure — no platform has access to your data or operations. For a fully configured solution, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, NOWPayments integration, and end-to-end testing, deployed in 48 hours.
